text: $ETH/$BTC is at 0.02831 and nudged up 0.855% against $BTC. Meanwhile $BTC itself rose 0.325% in the last 24 h. The 20-coin basket's average alt gain was 0.642%, so the whole alt set outpaced $BTC by a hair. Bottom line: $ETH is pulling a bit of strength on the BTC chart, and the broader alt crowd is doing slightly better than $BTC overall. Nothing wild, just a modest tilt toward the rest.

Meanwhile $SOXL tumbled 15.8% to $48.85, sliding from a $59.23 peak down to $46.99. Leaders grabbed the upside, laggards took the hit, just another wild 24-hour swing.

The 20-coin basket of top alts slipped 0.92% on average, leaving $BTC ahead of the pack. ETH's tiny edge on BTC is the only bright spot; the rest of the market stayed in the red. Nothing wild, just a modest BTC lead and a whisper of ETH out-performing.

$ETH is gaining a bit on $BTC, up 0.572% vs BTC's 0.43% drop. Meanwhile the 20-coin basket is ahead of Bitcoin, averaging a 2.73% rise. So BTC's underperforming both the alt basket and its main rival, while $ETH nudges ahead in the pair. Nothing wild, just $ETH tightening on $BTC and the alts taking the lead.

In other words, $BTC is underperforming the basket, and $ETH is nudging ahead of $BTC. Nothing wild, just a modest shift in relative strength.

$ETH slipped against $BTC, down 0.638% to 0.02803 BTC. Meanwhile $BTC fell 2.657% in USD terms, while the 20-coin basket lagged harder, down about 6.32% on average. So BTC's still beating the alt pack, but it's losing ground to $ETH. $ETH's modest gain versus BTC barely offsets the broader sell-off across the basket. Overall a rough 24-hour grind, with everything trending lower.

Bitcoin's still dragging the market while Uni's the sharpest drop-off in the basket. Nothing wild, just a clear split between the top mover and the biggest loser.

$SOL didn't lag far behind, bouncing close to an 11.9% range compared with its average 4.8%, again, over twice the everyday volatility.

All three busted out of their normal windows; nothing else stood out today.
